description: Run a read-only multi-LLM citation Share-of-Voice (SoV) and rank tracking audit across ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Grok (distinct from 'geo_content_write', which authors new Answer-First Markdown articles and '/vs/' tables). Use this tool to benchmark how often AI answer engines cite your 'domain' versus 'competitor_domains' for a 'prompt_topic' without generating or modifying content. Returns per-engine citation status, rank position, overall Share-of-Voice percentage, and competitor displacement metrics.

brand_name.description: Target brand or product name to audit across generative engines (e.g., "Argosor").

competitors.description: Optional list of up to 5 competitor domains to benchmark citation displacement against.

domain.description: Primary canonical root domain of the brand being audited (e.g., "argosor.com").

force_refresh.description: When true, bypasses the 6-hour response deduplication cache and forces a fresh multi-engine audit (default: false).

llm_engines.description: Optional subset of generative AI engines to include in the Share-of-Voice audit.

items.description: Identifier of the generative AI search engine to audit.

prompt_topic.default: best seo and geo api for ai agents
prompt_topic.description: High-intent buyer prompt or category topic used to evaluate Share-of-Voice across AI answer engines.

name: geo_llm_visibility_audit
title: GEO & Multi-LLM Citation Visibility Audit
